name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

achievements.name: Off the Plateau
achievements.detail: Claim the paraglider and glide off the Great Plateau into wider Hyrule.

achievements.name: Tower Activated
achievements.detail: Climb a Sheikah Tower and add its region to the map.

achievements.name: Shrine Clear
achievements.detail: Finish a shrine and take the Spirit Orb at the end.

achievements.name: Master Sword
achievements.detail: Pull the Master Sword from its pedestal in Korok Forest.

achievements.name: Divine Beast
achievements.detail: Free one Divine Beast by clearing its interior and the blight inside.

achievements.name: Four Beasts
achievements.detail: Free Vah Ruta, Vah Rudania, Vah Medoh, and Vah Naboris.

achievements.name: Fairy Upgrade
achievements.detail: Have a Great Fairy upgrade a piece of armor.

achievements.name: Registered Horse
achievements.detail: Tame a wild horse and register it at a stable.

achievements.name: Korok Seed
achievements.detail: Find a Korok and take the seed it was hiding.

achievements.name: Captured Memory
achievements.detail: Go to one pictured place and recover the memory waiting there.

achievements.name: Tarrey Town
achievements.detail: Finish From the Ground Up so Tarrey Town stands complete.

achievements.name: Hylian Shield
achievements.detail: Defeat the Stalnox under Hyrule Castle and take the Hylian Shield.

achievements.name: Calamity Ganon
achievements.detail: Win the final battle against Calamity Ganon.

achievements.name: Remembered Ending
achievements.detail: Finish the game after every captured memory has been restored.
